scope: Development-only visual prompting ablation; no new regression scores have been produced.
selection: Use the highest-confidence complete initial-frame YOLO player box with confidence>=0.65, height>=40pixels and no image-boundary contact. No manual player choice or reference labels. Fall back to person text if no eligible box exists.
variants: visual exemplar plus hockey player text
promotion: Same frozen development objective: correct-10*wrong, observation coverage, fewer uncertain joins. Only a winning recipe may be evaluated on reused regression.
limitations: One exemplar may bias detection toward its uniform, goalie equipment or team. An automatically chosen box is not a verified role or identity.
